name: ERP 事实接入与数量面三岗岗位包
description: 事实接入团队的岗位 preset 源：巡检岗（只读验收事件完整性与数量面水位）、核对岗（拟稿事件定性与补拟稿）、拍板岗（事实确认门与导入车道）。工具面引用 fd-erp-ledger-mcp 5 件，逐岗经 resources.mcpTools 收窄，包级 allowTools 只作封顶；数量面不可直写，资金执行一律拒绝（二清红线）。
notes: publish-ready 源清单（待上架/未发布，packId 未铸造）：三岗 persona 只做本地角色，不含 model/baseUrl/凭据；工具面仅引用 registryName=fd-erp-ledger-mcp 并显式声明 5 件 allowTools（包级封顶），再经 resources.mcpTools 按岗收窄（窄化而非放宽）。确认门工具（confirm_proposal / decide_event / approve_billing_rule / approve_posting_rule）只出现在拍板岗；写类工具不出现在巡检岗。消费方：erp-fact-intake-fleet 的三名成员 target。

en.name: ERP Fact Intake & Quantity — Three Posts
en.description: Role presets for the ERP fact-intake team: the inspector verifies event-stream completeness and quantity-face watermarks (read-only), the reconciler qualifies draft events and completes drafts, and the decider holds the fact confirmation gate and receives external facts through the import lane. Tool face references 5 tools of fd-erp-ledger-mcp, narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools. Quantity faces cannot be written directly; fund execution is refused outright.
en.notes: Publish-ready source: personas are local roles only, no credentials. Tool faces reference fd-erp-ledger-mcp with 5 explicit allowTools (pack ceiling), narrowed per post via resources.mcpTools. The fact confirmation gate (decide_event) appears on the decider only; the inspector holds no write face. Consumer: the three member targets of erp-fact-intake-fleet.

erp-fact-intake-discipline.description: Fact-intake three-post discipline: events are append-only, a draft that has not passed the confirmation gate is not a fact, reads must self-prove completeness, quantity faces cannot be written directly, confirmation gate belongs to the decider only, fund red line.
